title: Field monomorphisms representing points of a quasi-separated space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], with point classes and atlas topology [def-a1-space-point-topology]. Assume that the relative diagonal $X\to X\times_S X$ is quasi-compact: its pullback by every scheme is a quasi-compact scheme morphism, meaning that inverse images of quasi-compact opens are quasi-compact. For every $x\in|X|$ there are a field $F$ [def-weil-field] and a quasi-compact monomorphism $j:\operatorname{Spec}F\to X$ representing $x$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. A monomorphism here means that for every algebraic space $T$ over $S$, composition with $j$ is injective on morphisms from $T$.

source.place: Tags 03JX (lemma-bounded-fibres), (eta) implies (gamma), and 03JV (lemma-UR-finite-above-x), condition (4), for absolutely quasi-separated X (e.g. S affine, as in every current citer); for an arbitrary base scheme S: Tag 03M5 (lemma-properties-trivial-implications), a quasi-separated morphism X->S is decent, Tag 03JX (theta) implies (gamma) for the scheme S, and Tag 0ABY (lemma-property-over-property) with omega = decent, giving X decent, then 03JV (4).

proof.text: Choose a representable surjective etale atlas $V\to X$ by [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Cover $S$ by affine opens $B$ and cover each inverse image $V_B$ by affine opens $W_i$, using [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis]. These $W_i$ cover $V$, and each $W_i\to S$ factors through its chosen $B$. The composites $a_i:W_i\to X$ are representable etale: on any scheme test they are open immersions followed by the etale atlas projection, so apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation]. They are jointly surjective on point classes: a field representative of any point pulls the atlas back to a scheme surjective over that field, hence has an atlas point above it, and that point lies in some $W_i$. The jointly-surjective point convention is that of [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers].

source.place: Tag 03JV condition (2): choice of an etale covering; affine refinement over the base using schemes.tex Tag 01IT, and morphisms.tex Tags 02GP and 02GN.

proof.text: Fix $x\in|X|$. Each $a_i:W_i\to X$ satisfies [lem-sfb-relative-qs-affine-chart-point-fibres]: $W_i$ is affine, its map to $S$ factors through an affine open, and the relative diagonal is quasi-compact by hypothesis. Thus, putting $R_i=W_i\times_XW_i$ with first projection $p_i$, both $|a_i|^{-1}(\{x\})$ and $|a_i p_i|^{-1}(\{x\})$ are finite. This uses no absolute quasi-separatedness assumption on $S$.

source.place: Tag 03JX (lemma-bounded-fibres), (zeta) implies (gamma), and Tag 03JV condition (1), in the cited relative-affine-chart lemma.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-finite-chart-fibres-field-quasicompact] to the jointly surjective family $(a_i)$ and the fixed $x$. It says that every field-valued morphism representing $x$ is quasi-compact, on all affine scheme tests, not just on this covering. Since every field-valued morphism represents a point and $x$ was arbitrary, every field-valued morphism to $X$ is quasi-compact.

Now [lem-sfb-decent-quasicompact-monomorphic-points] applies over the original scheme $S$: its hypothesis is exactly the quasi-compactness of every field-valued morphism obtained in step 3. It yields, for every $x\in|X|$, a field $F$ and a quasi-compact monomorphism $\operatorname{Spec}F\to X$ representing $x$, with monomorphism tested on all algebraic spaces over $S$, as required. For $X=\varnothing$ the conclusion is vacuous.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03JX and 03JV, assembling the existing relative-affine-chart finiteness lemma with 03JV (2) to (6) to (4). The atlas is refined over affine opens of S; no absolute quasi-separatedness of S is assumed.

lean.statement: theorem exists_quasiCompact_monomorphic_field_representative_of_quasiSeparated {S : Scheme.{u}} (X : AlgebraicSpace S) (hqs : IsRepresentableWith (fun _ _ p ↦ QuasiCompact p.left) (prod.lift (𝟙 X.obj.obj) (𝟙 X.obj.obj))) (x : Point X.obj.obj) : ∃ (K : Type u) (_ : Field K) (b : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ S) (j : yoneda.obj (Over.mk b) ⟶ X.obj.obj), schemePointMap j (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K) = x ∧ (∀ (T : AlgebraicSpace S) (f g : T.obj.obj ⟶ yoneda.obj (Over.mk b)), f ≫ j = g ≫ j → f = g) ∧ IsRepresentableWith (fun _ _ p ↦ QuasiCompact p.left) j
